headline: 英國藝文三則側寫
context: 英國藝文圈本週有三則報導。琳達・馬修斯（Linda Matthews）原本在銀行界工作，2010年創辦兒童片場保護機構「Premier Chaperones」，過去十五年持續在片場守護未成年演員。巴西音樂人喬伊絲・莫瑞諾（Joyce Moreno）現年78歲，出道時因大膽歌詞與女性姿態引發爭議，還經歷過軍事獨裁時期的杯葛，如今已累積超過30張專輯。威尼斯影展則在歐洲「注意力經濟」危機的背景下，端出多部政治色彩鮮明的作品，包括導演謝爾蓋・洛茲尼察（Sergei Loznitsa）與艾力克斯・吉布尼（Alex Gibney）的新作。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Safeguarding young people in films is a vital role, often remembered by their charges later in successful careers, but not always recognised. Some of the best share their tips Linda Matthews has rarely had to stop a production in its tracks. Steve Stone’s 2017 psychological horror In Extremis was an exception. Set on an isolated country estate during an apocalyptic storm, it follows a family that have to confront the oncoming disaster and their own personal demons to survive. For Matthews, however, the real drama unfolded behind the camera. “I don’t mind being the big bad person,” she says. “I was working with a young girl who was playing a cancer patient. She had to wear a bald cap and everything. Just as we were about to film, she burst into tears. She told me it reminded her of her friend’s mum, who was going through cancer treatment. That was the end of that.” You may assume Matthews is a producer or a very hands-on investor, but you would be mistaken. After leaving a career in banking, she founded Premier Chaperones in 2010 and has spent the past 15 years safeguarding children on some of the world’s biggest film and television sets. sources.title: ‘Sometimes they credit the janitor. But not us’: what’s it like to be a child chaperone on a film set?

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: After her defiant femininity outraged many in Brazil, she lived through a military dictatorship and was boycotted for years. But after more than 30 albums, she explains how she kept going At 78, Joyce Moreno is one of Brazil’s musical icons, but for decades that status seemed far from assured: this headstrong singer, guitarist and composer was frequently viewed as a threat by her country’s establishment. Aged 19, the reaction to her song Me Disseram – which began “I was told my man didn’t love me” – almost torpedoed her career before it even started. “I’d often heard the expression ‘my man’ sung by Billie Holiday and Edith Piaf, so for me it was normal,” she says. “But I was a beach girl from Ipanema, writing and singing in the first person. People were shocked.” Then, inspired by trailblazing actor Leila Diniz (“her liberal attitudes lost her jobs”), Moreno refused requests that she “dress like a sexy bimbo”, and endured male critics who thought her music “too good to have been written by a woman”. When, in 1980, she discovered that her label had given another female singer the blueprints for songs she had written, she “looked for a lawyer, of course” and successfully sued; in her memoir she claims she was then boycotted by Brazil’s major record companies for a decade. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘Today’s Brazilians have no idea what it feels like to lose democracy’: Joyce Moreno on her battles to become a Latin musical great

The unedifying spectacle of the European Union’s falling out over the Ceuta crisis looks like the latest symptom of Europe’s shrinking attention economy. When more than 70,000 people crossed over from Morocco to the Spanish enclave of Ceuta at the start of the month, Rome hastily reintroduced air and sea border checks with Spain for one month; Madrid retaliated with spot-checks on travellers to Italy. thread_text:
英國藝文圈本週有三則報導。

琳達・馬修斯（Linda Matthews）原本在銀行界工作，2010年創辦兒童片場保護機構「Premier Chaperones」，過去十五年持續在片場守護未成年演員。巴西音樂人喬伊絲・莫瑞諾（Joyce Moreno）現年78歲，出道時因大膽歌詞與女性姿態引發爭議，還經歷軍事獨裁時期的杯葛，如今已累積超過30張專輯。威尼斯影展則在歐洲「注意力經濟」危機的背景下，端出多部政治色彩鮮明的作品，包括導演謝爾蓋・洛茲尼察（Sergei Loznitsa）與艾力克斯・吉布尼（Alex Gibney）的新作。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 12 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 英國藝文圈，本週有三則報導。琳達・馬修斯，原本在銀行界工作，二零一零年創辦了一間兒童片場保護機構，過去十五年，她一直在片場守護未成年演員。巴西音樂人喬伊絲・莫瑞諾，現年七十八歲，出道時因為大膽的歌詞和女性姿態引發爭議，還經歷過軍事獨裁時期的杯葛——如今，她已經累積超過三十張專輯。威尼斯影展這邊，在歐洲「注意力經濟」危機的背景下，端出了好幾部政治色彩鮮明的作品，包括導演謝爾蓋・洛茲尼察和艾力克斯・吉布尼的新作。
